title: Dua when intending to leave the Mosque
data:
When you intend to leave the mosque, you may say the following:
اَللّٰهُمَّ دَعَوْتَنِيْ فَاَجَبْتُ دَعْوَتَكَ وَصَلَّيْتُ مَكْتُوْبَتَكَ وَانْتَشَرْتُ فِيْ اَرْضِكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِيْ فَاَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَمَلَ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَاجْتِنَابَ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَالْكَفَافَ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ۔
ALLAAHUMMA DA-A'WTANEE FA-AJABTU DA'WATAK, WA SALLAYTU MAKTOOBATAK, WANTASHARTU FEE ARDIKA KAMAAA AMARTANEE, FA-AS-ALUKA MIN FADLIKAL A'MALA BI-TAA-A'TIKA WAJTINAABA MA'SIYATIK, WAL KAFAAFA MINAR RIZQI BI-RAHMATIK.
O Allah, You called me and I answered Your call, I performed Your prescribed prayer, and I spread out in Your land as You commanded me; so I ask You, of Your bounty, to act in obedience to You, to avoid disobeying You, and for sufficiency of sustenance through Your mercy.
